groups.title: U.A. Class 1-A — Boys
groups.def: Every male student of U.A.'s Class 1-A for the vast majority of the series (the original 20-person roster from the Entrance Exam through the Final War). Excludes Hitoshi Shinso, who only joins the class after Yuga Aoyama transfers out at the very end of the series.

groups.title: U.A. Class 1-A — Girls
groups.def: Every female student of U.A.'s Class 1-A for the vast majority of the series (the original 20-person roster from the Entrance Exam through the Final War).

groups.title: Class 1-A: Emitter-Type Quirks
groups.def: Members of the original 20-student Class 1-A roster whose Quirk is classified as Emitter-type.

groups.title: Class 1-A: Mutant-Type Quirks
groups.def: Members of the original 20-student Class 1-A roster whose Quirk is classified as Mutant-type.

groups.title: League of Villains
groups.def: The League's core members who lived together at the bar hideout, from its founding at the U.S.J. through the Paranormal Liberation War: leaders Shigaraki and Kurogiri, plus the five-member Vanguard Action Squad. Excludes All For One, the League's off-site original founder/backer, and hired outside muscle like Muscular.

groups.title: U.A. Teaching & Admin Staff
groups.def: U.A. High School faculty who appear as recurring, named characters across the anime (the principal, homeroom teachers, and other regularly-appearing staff) — not single-scene background teachers like Snipe, Ectoplasm, Hound Dog or Lunch Rush.

groups.title: The Todoroki Family
groups.def: Endeavor's wife and all four of their children, including estranged eldest son Dabi.

groups.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
groups.def: All four members of the pro hero team that ran the Forest Training Camp.

groups.title: Sports Festival Final Four
groups.def: The four students who reached the final four of the U.A. Sports Festival's first-year 1-on-1 tournament in Season 1: the champion, the runner-up, and the two students who tied for third place.

groups.title: The Kamino Rescue Squad
groups.def: The five Class 1-A students who snuck out against orders to rescue Bakugo from the League of Villains after the Kamino Incident, straining the rest of the class's trust in them.

groups.title: Transformation-Type Quirk Users
groups.def: Named characters whose Quirk this site classifies as Transformation-type (temporarily changes the user's body when activated).

groups.title: Meta Liberation Army Leadership
groups.def: The named commanders of the Meta Liberation Army introduced in Deika City during the Meta Liberation Army Arc.

groups.title: One For All's Confirmed Users
groups.def: Users of the One For All Quirk clearly shown on screen passing it on or using it: its first user, a later inheritor who mentored All Might, All Might himself, and his chosen successor.

groups.title: Hero names that are English words
groups.def: Heroes (pros and students) whose name as shown on the tile is an ordinary English dictionary word: Hawks, Endeavor, Thirteen, Midnight, Tiger, Ragdoll, and Kendo (a surname that is also the martial art).

groups.title: Villain names that are English words
groups.def: Villains whose name as shown on the tile is an ordinary English dictionary word, code name or not: Gentle, Twice, Stain, Compress, Overhaul, Muscular, Spinner, Curious, Trumpet, Skeptic, and Toga (her surname, also the Roman garment).
